fundamentals.networking-basics:section:h.alt: An HTTPS example over TCP. The client opens a connection to port 443, TLS verifies the server, and HTTP carries the request and response.

fundamentals.domain-dns:section:resoluti.alt: A recursive DNS resolver answers from its cache or queries authoritative DNS before caching the record and replying to the client.

fundamentals.cidr-subnets:section:cidr:c.alt: A regional VPC contains non-overlapping subnets across two Availability Zones. Each subnet belongs to one zone and receives an address range from the VPC CIDR.

fundamentals.routing-connectivity:sectio.alt: Three IPv4 paths compare direct public access to EC2, private EC2 egress through a public NAT gateway and internet gateway, and public Application Load Balancer access to a private EC2 target.
Traffic to a private service stays within the VPC on the local route. Traffic to Amazon S3 in the same Region follows the prefix list route to the S3 gateway endpoint.

fundamentals.cloud-concepts:section:shar.alt: EC2 and S3 responsibility comparison. Customers patch the EC2 guest OS, configure applications, set S3 bucket permissions, and choose encryption options. AWS runs the EC2 host and hypervisor, and the S3 service operating system and storage. Customers protect data and manage access in both services.

fundamentals.cloud-concepts:section:regi.alt: Two copies of an application run in different Availability Zones within one Region. One zone failure leaves the other copy running.

fundamentals.core-services:section:stora.alt: An application retrieves an S3 object using a key. An EC2 instance uses an attached EBS volume as block storage.

fundamentals.core-services:section:compo.alt: An S3 object upload triggers Lambda. The function reads the input, processes it, and writes a result to a destination bucket.

fundamentals.identity-access:section:pri.alt: A caller uses AWS STS to assume a role when the trust policy permits it. The role session uses temporary credentials and role permissions.

fundamentals.data-protection:section:enc.alt: HTTPS protects both connections from the browser to the API and from the API to S3. S3 encrypts the stored object. SSE-KMS uses an AWS KMS key.

fundamentals.data-protection:section:rec.alt: The timeline shows a recoverable point before the failure and service recovery after the failure. RPO concerns data loss, while RTO concerns recovery time.

fundamentals.domain-dns:section:ttl:conc.alt: One resolver caches the old IP address for five minutes. Another resolver gets the new address after the record changes. The cached answer can remain until its TTL expires.

fundamentals.routing-connectivity:sectio.alt: An Application Load Balancer opens HTTPS to a private EC2 target. Security groups control the connections at network interfaces, while network ACLs separately allow the request and return traffic at subnet boundaries.

fundamentals.cicd:section:artifacts-prom.alt: The same artifact digest is used in testing and production. The pipeline promotes the artifact only after the staging checks pass.

fundamentals.testing-quality:section:tes.alt: A unit test checks the tax calculation. An integration test checks the Order API and database together. An end-to-end test covers checkout through order confirmation.

fundamentals.release-rollback:section:de.alt: Rolling deployment replaces instances in groups. Blue and green environments allow a traffic switch. Canary deployment sends a small share of traffic first.

fundamentals.release-rollback:section:da.alt: Add a new database column first, allow old and new application releases to coexist, verify migrated data, and remove the old column after it is no longer used.

fundamentals.observability:section:signa.alt: Metrics show when order processing slowed. Logs help identify an affected request. Traces show where that request spent time across services.

fundamentals.observability:section:objec.alt: For the last 28 days, divide the orders that succeeded within 500 milliseconds by the eligible requests. Compare the result with the 99.9 percent objective.
